title: Chargers Mod
description: reimagined iconic monster from Advent of Ascension mod
body:
This mod adds new monster called Charger. This deadly birds can spawn during day and night and comes with seven diffrent variants that lives in specific biomes. All chargers drops feathers and bones so they can be good for grinding.

Mod was inspired by Chargers from Advent of Ascension mod made by Tslat and Xolova. Made with MCreator, models and textures made by me, sound effects comes from orginal mod.

You can use this in you modpack if you want
